indicators.flag: Client portfolio only consists of privacy coins or has a high value in privacy coins.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client transfers Bitcoin in large volumes in exchange for privacy coins.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client is unwilling or unable to provide information about the source of privacy coins they once held or currently have.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C14 (KYC integrity & customer-cooperation screening) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a customer whose KYC record shows integrity gaps or non-cooperation â overdue EDD documents, refused or evasive responses to information requests, or unresolved inconsistencies â escalating when cooperation failures persist past defined deadlines.
build_logic.source: case-management / KYC remediation system + customer correspondence log
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review & EDD gate

indicators.flag: VC addresses match addresses on recognized watch lists such as the list of the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) or law enforcement information.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C18 (Sanctions / watchlist screening).

indicators.flag: Many clients register with the exchange within a short period using a shared address, mobile device, phone number, IP addresses and other common identity indicators.
indicators.rationale: Gap; C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) needs D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data) enrichment.

indicators.flag: The client's VC wallet or address is linked to fraudulent activity in media reports and/or cyber security bulletins.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.flag: A platform receives unusual or persistent requests from other exchanges/vendors/service providers in respect of a client's deposited funds or VC.
indicators.red_flag: Persistent third-party trace requests on client funds
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.flag: A broker charges abnormally high commission fees compared to the industry standard.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C7 (Peer / business-activity anomaly (revenue-vs-operations) detection) on D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)).

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose transaction inflows are disproportionate to its declared revenue, headcount, payroll, or operating-expense footprint relative to industry peers, escalating when revenue appears decoupled from any observable operational activity.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: The white paper is of poor quality, incomplete, misleading, and has limited information.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.flag: Publicity is created around the initial coin offering (ICO) (advertisements, celebrity endorsements, social media ads), also known as pump and dump ICOs.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.flag: The developers are anonymous or information provided about the ICO cannot be verified.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.flag: There is no access to the smart contract, to the code or to technical information about the token's creation.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: There is no possibility to sell the investment or to exit the project to recover the invested funds.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: A series of complicated transfers of funds or VC to multiple addresses or wallets that seems to be an attempt to hide the source and/or intended use of the funds or VC.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Transactions take place at the same time of day. Transfers from fiat to VC and VC to fiat.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.flag: High volume and frequency of transfers between different types of VCs.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client provides an anonymous email address obtained through an encrypted email service.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Funds or VC are added or withdrawn from a VC address or wallet with direct and indirect exposure links to known suspicious sources, including darknet marketplaces, mixing/tumbling services, questionable gambling sites, illegal activities (for example, ransomware) and/or theft reports.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: The VC flows through a large number of intermediate addresses in a very short period of time prior to being added to a client's wallet, or just after being withdrawn.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: The VC passes through mixers/tumblers and is transferred to multiple wallets, where the VC is exchanged for funds.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: The VC originated from an over-the-counter trade broker that advertises its services as privacy-oriented/anonymous.
indicators.red_flag: Funds sourced from anonymity-marketing OTC broker
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client's wallet address has links or hops to or from a wallet address that has appeared on online platforms indicating support for violent extremism or radicalization (including social media, ads on fundraising sites, sites on Tor or messaging sites).
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: The source of funds used for the purchase of large amounts of VC is unknown.
indicators.red_flag: Unknown source of funds for large VC buy
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C8 (Income / occupation-vs-activity profile-inconsistency detection) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: The email address used in the transaction is linked to advertisements for the sale of VC on peer to peer exchange platforms. These advertisements may suggest that the client is buying and selling VC on a commercial scale through a business as a non-registered money services business.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.flag: The client frequently receives funds from multiple payment processors.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: The client makes frequent payments or transfers to companies, post office mailing services or uses money orders from agents of the Crown for the purchase of computer software or hardware.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C9 (Merchant-category (MCC) / spend-pattern screening) on D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate
